```{r}
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(qreport)
source("../Scripts/00-config.R")

# Read in data
combined_stats_table <- read_rds(data_file("processed_stats", "combined_stats_table.rds"))
```

# Season `r nbl_config$active_season_label`

```{r}
# Get each teams season averages
points_by_team <-
combined_stats_table |>
    filter(season == nbl_config$active_season) |>
    filter(!is.na(score)) |> 
    distinct(match_id, name, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
        group_by(name) |>
    summarise(avg_points_scored = mean(score), avg_points_conceded = mean(opp_score)) |>
    arrange(desc(avg_points_scored))

```
